scenarios.label: SSH real failure
scenarios.sample: Oct 17 02:03:04 edge-a sshd[312]: Failed password for invalid user organizer from 198.51.100.7 port 55522 ssh2
scenarios.expected: SSH failure is classified; account=organizer and source address recorded; original file/line retained

scenarios.label: SSH success neighbor
scenarios.sample: Oct 17 02:03:05 edge-a sshd[312]: Accepted password for organizer from 198.51.100.7 port 55522 ssh2
scenarios.expected: Accepted password is not reported as a failed-login finding

scenarios.label: HTTP 401 neighbor
scenarios.expected: Generic HTTP 401 alone never proves an application authentication failure

scenarios.label: Explicit admin failure
scenarios.sample: 2026-10-17T02:03:07Z auth event=organizer_admin_login_failed account=manager42 ip=198.51.100.7
scenarios.expected: Configured application auth failure must be classified with account and source

scenarios.label: Benign punctuation
scenarios.expected: Lone semicolon or punctuation in parameter does not classify as injection

scenarios.label: Hostile command substitution
scenarios.expected: Context-aware rule detects encoded command-substitution indicator as suspected, not proven execution

scenarios.label: Hostile conjunctive pattern
scenarios.sample: 2026-10-17T02:08:00Z web request.query="host=router;cat /etc/passwd" status=403
scenarios.expected: Documented metacharacter plus command pattern in request field is suspected injection

scenarios.label: Non-input mentions attack
scenarios.sample: 2026-10-17T02:08:01Z app logger=docs message="help article explains $(command) syntax"
scenarios.expected: A description outside configured request-input fields is not a hostile request finding

scenarios.label: Malformed escapes
scenarios.expected: Malformed URL encoding must be bounded, accounted and never silently substituted

scenarios.label: Missing timestamp
scenarios.sample: web-a sshd[34]: Failed password for organizer from 198.51.100.10 port 2222 ssh2
scenarios.expected: Preserve raw recorded time and mark timeline time untrusted/unknown, do not fabricate offset

scenarios.label: Quoted fields/terminal escape
scenarios.sample: 2026-10-17T03:00:00Z input="[31mhello[0m" token=SECRET_SAMPLE_TOKEN
scenarios.expected: Never allow terminal escape execution and redact token in ordinary output

scenarios.label: Duplicate evidence
scenarios.sample: Same bytes repeated in two distinct selected exports
scenarios.expected: Each selected physical file retains original identity and hash; aggregate unique-event policy explicit

scenarios.label: Cross-host burst
scenarios.sample: Five explicit SSH failures in a configured short interval on host-a and host-b
scenarios.expected: Time/grouping thresholds configurable; show member provenance and no attribution of identity

scenarios.label: Spray candidate
scenarios.sample: One origin fails against five distinct organizer accounts
scenarios.expected: Show distinct account count and list of source events, not proof of single attacker

scenarios.label: Corrupt gzip
scenarios.sample: Compressed file has valid gzip header followed by truncated compressed stream
scenarios.expected: Archive error retained with source disposition; run not fully complete

scenarios.label: Unreadable file
scenarios.sample: One selected input denied by filesystem permissions
scenarios.expected: Manifest contains selected unreadable file and run cannot claim full completion

scenarios.label: Invalid regex
scenarios.sample: User config defines syntax-invalid pattern / unbounded costly expression
scenarios.expected: Invalid pattern refused before any evidence processing; actionable diagnostic

scenarios.label: Interrupt and resume
scenarios.sample: Process interrupted during large multi-gzip file selection
scenarios.expected: Partial files distinguishable; no complete marker or successful exit

scenarios.label: Secret in URL
scenarios.sample: GET /diagnostics?token=SECRET_SAMPLE_TOKEN&cmd=%24%28id%29
scenarios.expected: Finding retains safe rule context but no raw token in JSONL, CSV, Markdown or progress

scenarios.label: Multi-rule one event
scenarios.sample: A request contains independently configured two distinct injection signatures
scenarios.expected: One unique event finding may carry multiple rules; count unique events and total rule matches separately

scenarios.label: Malformed UTF8
scenarios.sample: Evidence stream contains 0xff bytes amid otherwise valid records
scenarios.expected: Bytes preserved for hash; undecodable record counted; no invented replacement original

scenarios.label: Long hostile input
scenarios.sample: Single log event has attacker-controlled field beyond configured bound
scenarios.expected: Memory and regex time bounded, event accounted as truncated/unclassified, not silently erased

scenarios.label: Unknown tz
scenarios.sample: Syslog event lacks timezone and no operator timezone policy
scenarios.expected: Raw time retained, no UTC instant claim; chronological order clearly partial

scenarios.label: Repeat run
scenarios.sample: Two invocations with exact same evidence and same rule bytes
scenarios.expected: Deterministic substantive findings, with run metadata allowed to vary and new output directory

scenarios.label: Directory symlink
scenarios.sample: Evidence directory includes a symlink to file outside authorized root
scenarios.expected: Cannot follow unexpected symlink outside selected collection; record source disposition

scenarios.label: Source remains immutable
scenarios.sample: Evidence sample and gzip archived before/after run
scenarios.expected: Raw input SHA-256 unchanged; output outside input tree or safe exclusions

scenarios.label: No network
scenarios.sample: Auditor executes against offline folder with no connectivity
scenarios.expected: No external upload, download, blocking, scanning or rule refresh; only local I/O

scenarios.label: Corrupt config
scenarios.sample: TOML rule lacks required version, ID or field selector
scenarios.expected: Validation fails before starting run; no ambiguous rule identity

scenarios.label: Bounded normalization
scenarios.sample: Nested URL encoding applied repeatedly beyond configured limit
scenarios.expected: Configured maximum decode depth respected; encoded and raw provenance retained

scenarios.label: Malformed multiline
scenarios.sample: Console continuation line at file start, no prior event header
scenarios.expected: Line is accounted with determinable source line; do not attach to fabricated prior event

scenarios.label: Timezone ordering
scenarios.sample: ISO Z and HTTP +0200 records representing same instant
scenarios.expected: Correctly normalize only when offset known; stable deterministic secondary ordering

scenarios.label: Noisy response
scenarios.sample: HTTP access 404 containing word failed in user agent
scenarios.expected: Pattern requires source-specific auth evidence; preserve not classified event count

scenarios.label: Real samples later
scenarios.sample: Client sanitized records and independent analyst labels available for acceptance
scenarios.expected: Measure confusion matrix precision/recall and disclose FP/FN; no fabricated numeric goal

scenarios.label: Weekend-size load
scenarios.sample: Representative busy-weekend log dataset and standard Linux machine
scenarios.expected: Record input size, wall time, CPU/memory process peak RSS and scaling; no invented throughput threshold

scenarios.label: CLI status distinction
scenarios.sample: Success, warnings, unreadable selected file, fatal configuration
scenarios.expected: Machine-readable manifest and CLI exit distinguish complete, warning, failure/incomplete

scenarios.label: One command report
scenarios.sample: Novel documented mix of supported SSH, HTTP and console logs
scenarios.expected: JSON Lines, readable summary, manifest with hashes, unclassified accounting, context and version
